{{Quote|The Koorivar have done a good job with their weather machines. Whipped up one brute of a sky. We used the same tactic on Paarin Minor. Drew the Seps into fabricated clouds and blew them to the back of beyond.|Salvo, to Roan Shryne|audio=WeUsedTheSameTacticOnPaarinMinor-DarkLord.flac|<ref name="Dark Lord" />}}
[[Paarin Minor]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and stronghold of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Dark Lord" /> in the  [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding information for the [[Paarin Minor system/Legends|Paarin Minor system]]</ref> was '''attacked''' by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] at some point<ref name="Dark Lord" /> between [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic forces]], which included the [[32nd Air Combat Wing]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Salvo (clone trooper)|Salvo]], utilized a [[Weather-control station|weather-control machine]] to create artificial [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] cover over their position which screened them from [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederate forces]]. When the Separatist [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] emerged from the clouds, the Republic forces opened fire, causing heavy casualties and forcing the Separatists to retreat.<ref name="CSWE" />

At the end of the war,<ref name="Dark Lord" /> Salvo and the 32nd Air Combat Wing<ref name="CSWE" /> participated in an [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|attack]] on the planet [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]], where the Separatists [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] inhabitants deployed a similar tactic. During the battle however, Salvo informed [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Roan Shryne]] about the tactic and Republic forces countered the Separatist defense.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'', a [[2005]] novel written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Dark Lord" /> The book was the third novel included in Luceno's and [[Matthew Stover]]'s [[2008]] ''[[The Dark Lord Trilogy]]''.<ref name="Dark Lord Trilogy">''[[The Dark Lord Trilogy]]''</ref>
